title: Keep schedules in UTC
body: Sam works in UTC, but crontab lines run in the browser's local time. Say the time zone when you add a schedule.

prompt: Draft a skill in ~/.pi/agent/skills/harbor-forecast that documents the forecast API endpoints and the city:UTC-date cache keys.
